title: Cookie Policy for AfriNuts Export
description: Our Cookies Policy explains how AfriNuts uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience, improve our services, and analyze website traffic.

whatAreCookies.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.description: Cookies are small data files placed on your device (computer, smartphone, tablet) when you visit a website. They help websites remember your preferences, improve user experience, and deliver relevant content. We use both first-party cookies (set by AfriNuts Export) and third-party cookies (set by analytics, marketing, or service providers).

essential.title: a. Essential Cookies
essential.description: These cookies are necessary for the basic functioning of our site. They enable core services such as security, network management, and accessibility.

performance.title: b. Performance Cookies
performance.description: These cookies collect anonymous data about how visitors interact with our site. This helps us improve website functionality and understand visitor behavior.
examples: Tools used: Google Analytics or similar
Data: Page views, click patterns, bounce rates

functional.title: c. Functional Cookies
functional.description: Functional cookies remember your choices (like language or region) and help provide enhanced features.
examples: Disabling may affect parts of the website experience

advertising.title: d. Advertising Cookies
advertising.description: These cookies may be set by us or our marketing partners to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant ads.
examples: We currently do not run third-party ads, but reserve the right to in the future
These cookies do not store direct personal information

managingPreferences.title: 3. Managing Cookie Preferences
managingPreferences.description: You can manage or change your cookie settings at any time through our Cookie Preferences Center or via your browser settings.
steps: Adjust settings for each cookie type: Essential (locked), Performance, Functional, Advertising

thirdPartyCookies.title: 4. Third-Party Cookies
thirdPartyCookies.description: Some cookies may be placed by third-party services we use to analyze traffic or enhance features. These third parties may collect information about your device and online activity. We ensure that any third-party partners comply with data protection regulations such as GDPR and CCPA, where applicable.

dataRetention.title: 5. Data Retention
dataRetention.description: Cookies have different lifespans: Session cookies expire when you close your browser, while persistent cookies remain on your device for a set period or until deleted.

yourRights.title: 6. Your Rights
yourRights.description: You have the right to: Access and correct personal data, withdraw consent for non-essential cookies, and lodge a complaint with a data protection authority if needed.

changesToPolicy.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
changesToPolicy.description: We may update this Cookie Policy to reflect changes in our practices, technology, or legal obligations. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised "Last Updated" date.
